The table of provisions, running heads and footers are dropped; the cover is kept as the file prints it (twice). Each provision starts on its own line with its number; paragraphs are indented two spaces a level; the register's marginal history notes are kept as "[Side note: ...]" lines before the provision they annotate; tables are "| a | b |" rows; Word equations are linearised in place. The endnotes (amendment history) are kept. Nothing else is changed.
